profile.headline: Self-taught web developer | Full-stack | React, Next.JS | Node.JS, Express, Mongoose, TypeScript | Docker, Kubernetes
profile.summary: I'd characterize myself as a purpose-driven individual. To that end, I can always be counted on to exert much effort, and hard work into whatever I do. To me, versatility, and adaptation are the key mentalities one should adopt in order to not only overcome the daily rigors of life whether it be in a workplace environment or elsewhere, but for his own personal growth. Thus, I'm always interested in expanding my skillsets/knowledge to continually improve the quality of my work, and my own development. It's for these reasons that I think I'd be a nice addition to a team-based position.

positions.title: Self-taught Web Developer
positions.description:
As a self-taught web developer concentrating in the MERN tech stack, I'm looking forward to working in the tech industry in order to learn new skillsets, and to have fun.

Projects:
Microservices – Movie ticket application (personal project developed independently)
Purpose: allows users to view available movies for purchasing tickets.

    • Individual project services were built using Express, JavaScript, and Node.JS.
    • Built server-side rendered client service using Next.JS to serve as front-end.
    • Custom module library developed using TypeScript, and JavaScript for common service functionality.
    • Containerization and cluster communication were handled using Docker, and Kubernetes, respectively.
    • Ingress-nginx was used as a load balancer to handle request traffic.
    • Cross-service data replication was built using TypeScript, JavaScript, and MongoDB.
    • Cross-service event communication was developed using Node.JS, and supplemented by using nats-streaming-server as an event bus.
    • Unit testing was implemented using a combination of Jest, and Postman.
    • Continuous integration was implemented using both Git, and GitHub. 

Full-stack – To-Do/Weather forecast application (personal project developed independently)
Purpose: allows users to log their personal action items, and to view their local weather forecast.

    • Front-end client was built using a combination of React.JS, and React-Redux.
    • Client HTTP communication was handled using Axios.
    • User interface was modified using the Bootstrap CSS library for styling purposes. 
    • Back-end codebase was built using both Express.JS, and Node.JS.
    • Data storage was handled using both Mongoose, and MongoDB.
    • User registration, and authorization were handled using the third-party library, bcryptjs.
    • User authentication was handled using jsonwebtoken.
    • Weather forecast service was implemented by using a free third-party API from OpenWeather.

positions.title: Research Associate II
positions.locationName: South San Francisco, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
As a member of the R&D process engineering team for AstraZeneca's respiratory division, my main functions were to collaborate with both the analytics, and the formulation science teams in order to produce inhalation products for pre-clinical trials.  

Responsibilities:
    • Production Lead – led development/GLP campaigns; interacted with formulation scientists to finalize API/Placebo formulations; drafted batch production records; oversaw materials/consumables acquisition and inventory management; calculated process parameters to achieve desired product properties; handled manufacturing/analytical scheduling; presented production plan/campaign results
    • Performed relevant analytical testing for development studies: SEMs, SSA, DSC, pPSD, aVMD
    • Interacted with QA in regards to GMP/GLP-related documentation: investigations/deviations/CAPAs; change-controls
    • Led and assisted with GMP/R&D equipment design, and modifications
    • Process systems – operated/assembled/disassembled/cleaned GMP/R&D spray dryers; performed system characterization tests; maintained spare parts inventory; led/assisted with IH monitoring for various process systems; assisted in drafting system documentation; assisted with system build-outs

positions.title: Shift Supervisor
positions.description:
• Supervised fellow coworkers on customer service, floor tasks, health standards, and individual development.
• Maintained both Eco-sure and Starbucks health standards throughout shifts, and during inspections.
• Managed cash inventory on a daily basis. 
• Maintained product inventory by performing counts, mark-outs, and par counts.
• Oversaw both customer, and coworker care by filing, and maintaining incident reports.

positions.title: Barista and Trainer
positions.description:
• Provided excellent service through customer interaction, speed of service, and beverage quality. 
• Trained new employees in Starbucks’ policies, job requirements, and health regulations.

positions.title: Poster
positions.description:
• Placed signs according to predetermined routes. 
• Maintained weekly, and monthly reports of sign inventory.
